name: Autocompletion
author: Synapse
description: Suggestions as you write a note, in grey after the cursor (Tab accepts), from a model running on this computer in Ollama: your notes are not sent anywhere else.

settings.label: Model
settings.description: A model installed in Ollama; one that fills in the middle (qwen2.5-coder:1.5b, small and fast; qwen2.5-coder:7b, better, needs about 8 GB of memory) also sees the text after the cursor.

settings.label: Ollama address
settings.description: Where Ollama listens; only addresses on this computer are accepted.
